mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: current temperatures are 57 degrees with overcast skies at Harriet Park and a Waxing Gibbous moon. Overnight, the temperature will drop to 55 degrees with no rain predicted.

The City is starting road maintenance on September 23 with chip sealing on Cross Country Road, East Verona Avenue, and Liberty Business Park, requiring some traffic control. Additionally, the Plan Commission is reviewing several development projects on October 5, including new site plans and surveys.

There is plenty to do this weekend, including the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival, live music at Bailey's Run, and the Bike the Barns fundraiser all happening today. Looking ahead, you can catch trivia on Tuesday at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus the Downtown Farmer's Market on Tuesday.
On September 5, an officer investigated a report of vehicles having cheese slices placed on their windshields throughout the downtown area, which was identified as a social media trend.
Culver's is closed for the evening, but you can plan your next visit for tomorrow's flavor of the day when they reopen at 10:00 AM.
